fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, transforming his weapon into a cannon and gaining the ability to recast ''Curtain Call'' 4 times within the duration.
fields.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} After {{fd|0.2}} seconds into the cast time, '''Jhin''' fires a round in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health.}}}}. The bullet stops upon hitting an enemy champion, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds. Each cast has a {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} of 1 second.

fields.description3: The fourth shot {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} damage.
